subject: Your 3-minute routine starts tonight
preview_text: Couples who use this one habit plan 4x more dates. Here's how.
body_paragraphs: You and your partner probably already have a nightly routine — brushing teeth, checking phones, maybe a quick 'love you' before sleep. There's a gap in that routine, one 3-minute slot that could make everything else feel different. Most couples miss it. They scroll, they forget, they let the spark slip into the to-do list.

Here's the thing: habits aren't built on motivation. They're built on triggers. The 3-minute routine is simple: open SoulPlan right after you both brush your teeth. Tap one mood — cozy, adventurous, playful, healing. That's it. In under three minutes, you've planted a seed for tomorrow night. The app does the rest, drawing from your Wishlist and the AI to make it happen.

The couples who do this — just 3 minutes before bed — don't just plan more dates. They start to feel like the kind of couple who prioritizes each other. The streak counter gives a gentle nudge, but the real win is the identity shift: you become the couple who plans together. Your home screen already shows both avatars. Make it mean something.

Tonight, before you close your eyes, open SoulPlan and pick one mood. Just three minutes. That's all it takes to build a habit that changes how you show up. P.S. The memory you'll see on the Timeline in a month? That starts with tonight's tap.
